_comment: Albums the Spotify search endpoint does not surface, pinned to their verified album URIs. Add a pin only after verifying via `spotify-api experience --id <uri>` that the record's track list matches the album. Pins bypass the library-edition preference (no pinned album is in the library as of 2026-11-06); if one is saved later, remove its pin so the saved edition wins. Search is tried first for everything else; pins are a fallback for search-invisible records only, not a replacement for search.

pins.note: Search never surfaces Ride's Nowhere, bare or artist-scoped; the artist page caps at the 5 most recent albums. URI taken from the album's public link; experience returns the 15-track Nowhere (Expanded) tracklist opening with the 8 original LP tracks (Seagull through Taste).
